serbia-law (public, pinned 1329108 = main) holds 9,749 acts scraped from the official PIS register as consolidated texts with in-force history, including the Constitution with the 2022 amendments and all six main codes, current to 2026-11-07. Its README and jurisdiction.json still say it holds only the Constitution; the PIS reuse terms, which a Lexifina memory says forbid automated extraction without Službeni glasnik's consent, are not mentioned anywhere in the repository; there is no Vojvodina law and no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
